# Missing Token Error Handling

The implementation requires a GitHub token for API access. If the token is not set, it raises a ForgeError. This could lead to runtime failure if not managed properly in dependent code.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.__init__`
